# Native Black document layout

This library starts with Ruff 0.16.10's Rust formatter component 0.0.16.
It is private build support for `mamba-quality`.
Mamba applies Black 26.10.0's fixed stable behavior here.
The unmodified Ruff formatter is not accepted as Black behavior.
Original-tool comparisons live in the quality crate.
`upstream.json` preserves the original archive and source hashes.
Changes must retain the original MIT license and add Black's MIT license.
